 THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 10.04.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:31838  2 CRL.MC NO. 3171 OF 2025  ORDER The petitioner is the accused in C.C. No.1867 of 2014 pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court- III, Thiruvananthapuram.
The case originated from a crime registered against the petitioner for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The petitioner's failure to appear on summons has resulted in issuance of non-bailable warrant against him.
This Crl.M.C. is filed seeking an opportunity to surrender and a direction to the court below to consider petitioner's bail application on the day of surrender itself.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.

Considering the willingness to surrender expressed by the petitioner and the limited relief sought,
the Crl.M.C is disposed of as under;
(i) Petitioner is permitted to surrender before the jurisdictional Magistrate Court within two weeks,
after giving advance notice to the Public Prosecutor.
2025:KER:31838 CRL.MC NO. 3171 OF 2025 (ii) If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, his application for bail shall be considered and orders passed on the day of surrender itself.
(iii) Execution of the non-bailable warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for two weeks.
